note: Course map for Networks, Crowds, and Markets (cm-course-ncm, 2026-10-14). The book is a map only: no text, figures or exercises are copied; titles are used to locate ideas. The cs.cornell.edu site and PDF mirrors were blocked (proxy 403), so section numbers and titles come from my knowledge of the 2010 table of contents, checked against web-search snippets. "confirmed": true only where a snippet showed the number and title (source recorded); everything else is unconfirmed and must not be cited as a section in curriculum.references (head-of-product rule) until someone with the book checks it. Exercise sections are omitted. demoable = a learner can make one prediction that a stage shows in under 60 seconds with a checkable answer. status: covered (a built lesson teaches it), batch1 (session 2's batch-1 list), gap (briefed in company/courses/ncm/briefs.md), not-demoable (reason in why). Coverage is an input metric, not learner value. Wave J (2026-10-14): 'briefed_wave_j' lists additional briefs for concepts in already-covered sections; four sections were re-judged demo-able (why_before_wave_j keeps the old reason).
